title: Orchi settings
description: ~/.config/orchi/settings.json. Every key can be left out, and then its default holds. No secret is ever a setting, the Linear API key included.

claude_dir.description: The Claude Code profile folder. Sessions Orchi starts run under it. Left out, Claude Code's own: ~/.claude, or the shell's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for a session.

orchi_dir.description: Orchi's checkout, whose bin/ holds the scripts.

legwork_dir.description: The legwork tracker. Left out, there is none.

worker_limit.description: Workers that can run at once, across every run.

usage_guard_percent.description: How full a usage limit can get, in percent, before usage-guard asks a session to pause.

sources.description: The ticket sources planning reads. Legwork is always one, listed or not.

own_owners.description: GitHub users and organisations that are yours.

repos.description: The repos whose issues are tickets, as owner/repo.

teams.description: The Linear teams to pull in, by key. None means the issues assigned to you.

projects.description: The Linear projects to pull in, by id.

repos.description: The folder each Linear team's work happens in, by team key.

legwork_projects.description: The legwork project file each Linear project belongs to, by Linear project id.

paths.description: Markdown task files, or folders of them.
